entry.title: St. Agatha’s Tower
entry.note: Mapped Red Tower way91447984 carries ref:nicpmi00033, matching the national inventory for Saint Agatha’s Tower and the custodian name/website. Entrance node3898282959 is on the southeast-facing wall and establishes signed native+Z. +X follows the mapped entrance facade toward east-northeast. The projected outline preserves the four slightly unequal corner turrets; scarped foundation and roof elevations are reconstructed from custodian photographs, not claimed surveyed. Terrain contact is at the tower foundation. Stair flight follows the photographed entrance axis and reconstructed rise; hillside retaining walls, the separate star-shaped entrenchment and terrain steps remain map/terrain features. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
